evidence.reason: In drain_queue the loop breaks on result["drained"] before checking the deadline, and it sleeps the full --drain-interval-s. A blocked first poll can therefore sleep past --drain-deadline-s, then accept a drained second poll after expiry and proceed. That contradicts the explicit deadline behavior (FailStop when the queue does not drain in time); the fix is to cap each sleep at the remaining time and re-check expiry before accepting a drained result, while preserving an immediate first-poll success.
